macros.name: idxlayout
macros.doc: The command \idxlayout, which takes a comma-separated list of key–value options as argument, allows to change index layout parameters within the document.

macros.name: indexstheadcase
macros.doc: The \indexstheadcase command allows to avoid hard-coding \MakeUppercase into the index header definition (as is currently done by the standard classes).

macros.name: noindexprenote
macros.doc: With multiple indexes, use the command \noindexprenote to reset the prenote text to empty and to take care of the proper spacing between index heading and first entry.
